about: The Deep paint decomposition set in the helper registry (electron/main/onnx/models.js fromSetCatalogue; docs/PLAN_SURFACE_PAINT.md SP2). Scumble's ONNX export of Marigold-IID-Lighting v1.1 (tools/deeppaint/export_onnx.py from prs-eth/marigold-iid-lighting-v1-1 @ 08c3930b, the fp16 variant, float32 in and out, the empty-prompt embedding baked into the UNet). Sizes and sha256 are the exported files' (docs/measurements/sp0_2026-11-13/sha256.txt). Not offered for download until the files are uploaded to the hosting repo (no `base`, so no file has a URL): then `base` gets that repo's resolve URL at the upload's commit. Files put into the folder by hand are used meanwhile (the tests do).
label: Marigold IID Lighting
note: splits the picture into colour, light and reflections (Deep paint)

terms.text: Marigold IID Lighting by ETH Zurich's Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing group, CreativeML Open RAIL++-M: an ONNX export of their weights, about {size}, downloaded from {host}. The licence allows commercial use of the model and of your pictures and passes on its use restrictions: the model may not be used for the purposes its Attachment A lists (among them harm to minors, defamation, disinformation, and discrimination).
